 Trae Young solid in loss Monday 
 by Leo Sells | Wizards Correspondent | Tue, Nov 10th 2026, 12:33pm EST 
 Trae Young scored 20 points (6-17 FG, 3-10 3PT, 5-9 FT) and dished out seven assists in Monday's 122-111 loss to the Detroit Pistons. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Young looked pretty good on Monday with 20 points and seven assists, but he wasn't very efficient from the field, which didn't help his fantasy total at all. He should continue to be a good, but not great, fantasy option for the foreseeable future.
